title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 28: the blessings for listening to Yahweh's voice and the curses for not listening.

questions.text: If Israel listens diligently to Yahweh's voice, where will Yahweh set them?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that if they listen diligently and do all his commandments, Yahweh will set them high above all the nations of the earth.

answers.text: High above all the nations of the earth
In the middle of the wilderness

questions.text: Enemies who come out against Israel one way will flee before them in how many ways?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will cause their enemies to be struck before them; they come out one way and flee "seven ways."

questions.text: What will Yahweh open his good treasure in the sky to give?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will open his good treasure in the sky to give the rain of their land in its season and to bless all the work of their hands.

questions.text: Complete the promise: "Yahweh will make you the head, and not the ..."
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: "Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail."

questions.text: Among the curses, what will the sky over their head be like?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says the sky over their head will be bronze and the earth under them will be iron.

questions.text: Why will they gather little from the much seed they carry out into the field?
questions.explanation: They will carry much seed into the field and gather little in, "for the locust will consume it."

questions.text: What will Yahweh put on their neck when they serve their enemies?
questions.explanation: Verse 48 says they will serve their enemies in hunger, thirst and nakedness, and he will put an iron yoke on their neck.

questions.text: The nation Yahweh brings from far will come as which bird flies?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will bring a nation from the end of the earth "as the eagle flies," a nation whose language they will not understand.

questions.text: Because of their fear, what will they say in the morning?
questions.explanation: In the morning they will say, "I wish it were evening!" because of the fear of their heart and the sights their eyes will see.

questions.text: How will Yahweh bring them into Egypt again?
questions.explanation: Verse 68 says Yahweh will bring them into Egypt again with ships, where they will offer themselves as slaves and nobody will buy them.
